name: CookieGuard – Cookie Consent Manager
author: CG Team

sections.description:
CookieGuard is a lightweight, beautifully designed cookie consent plugin that helps your website comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations.

Why CookieGuard?

  • Beautiful by default – Modern, clean designs that match your brand
  • Lightweight – No bloat, fast loading
  • Easy to customize – Visual editor with live preview right in WordPress
  • Compliant – GDPR, CCPA, and ePrivacy ready
  • Responsive – Looks great on all devices
  • No account required – Works out of the box with one click

Features

  • One-click setup – No account creation needed
  • Multiple banner types (bar, modal, panel)
  • Multiple positions (bottom, top, corners, center)
  • Full color customization
  • Custom button text
  • Cookie preference management
  • Consent logging and analytics
  • Lightweight embed script
  • Developer friendly (events and API)

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Customize your banner in the visual editor
  3. Run a cookie scan to detect cookies on your site
  4. That’s it! Your cookie banner is live.

The plugin connects to the CookieGuard service for cookie scanning. All data transmission is initiated by the site administrator through explicit actions in the admin dashboard.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party service. By using this plugin you agree to its terms and privacy policy.

CookieGuard API (api.cookieguard.app)

This plugin transmits data to the CookieGuard service in the following cases:

  • When you run a cookie scan from the admin dashboard: your site URL is sent to initiate a remote scan that detects cookies set by your site

All API communication is initiated by the site administrator through explicit actions in the WordPress admin dashboard. No data is sent automatically on frontend page loads or without administrator action.

Data sent to CookieGuard: site URL.

No visitor data, WordPress user data, passwords, or personally identifiable information is transmitted by this plugin.

Service URL: https://api.cookieguard.app
Terms of Service: https://cookieguard.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://cookieguard.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/cookieguard-wp
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to CookieGuard in the admin menu
  4. Customize your banner in the Banner Editor
  5. Run a cookie scan to detect cookies on your site
sections.faq:
Is CookieGuard GDPR compliant?

Yes! CookieGuard provides all the necessary features for GDPR compliance including consent collection, preference management, and consent storage with anonymized IPs.

Do I need to create an account?

No! The WordPress plugin works without creating an account. Just install, activate, and start customizing your banner.

Can I customize the colors and text?

Absolutely! Use the visual Banner Editor to customize colors, text, positioning, layout, and more – all with a live preview.

Does this slow down my site?

No. The banner script is extremely lightweight and loads asynchronously from our CDN.

Where is consent data stored?

Consent data is stored securely on CookieGuard’s servers with GDPR-compliant data handling. IP addresses are anonymized and no personal tracking occurs.

Can I use this with caching plugins?

Yes! The banner script loads dynamically and works perfectly with all major caching plugins.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Added Google Consent Mode v2 support
  • Added geo-targeting by region
  • Added multiple new banner types: floating_bar, split_screen, compact_pill, full_page
  • Added consent version control to invalidate previous consents on policy changes
  • Added cookie preference management modal
  • Added consent logs viewer with export
  • All features fully unlocked (no Pro gating)
  • Improved banner customization options
  • Improved admin UI with dark theme and live preview editor
  • Fixed cookie blocking for functional/advertisement category mapping
  • Fixed cookie monitor to catch late-loading third-party cookies
  • Fixed scanner retry logic for scheduled scans
  • Fixed sensitive config data exposure on frontend
  • Improved API response validation for cookie scanner

1.1.0

  • Added cookie scanner with scheduled scans
  • Added custom cookie management (add/edit/delete)
  • Added script blocking with data-cookieguard-category attribute support
  • Performance improvements to frontend banner script

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • One-click site registration
  • Full banner customization
  • API integration with CookieGuard
